name: classic-city-core/card-detail-rows
title: Card with Detail Rows
description: Grid of data cards. Each card stacks an eyebrow, an h3, a hairline-separated list of label → value detail rows, a WYSIWYG description, and an optional button pinned to the bottom edge. The block-level color picker paints each CARD (not the grid), and the card border defaults to that color's palette partner (its “alt”).
